ODNode.doc: An ODNode object serves as a Cocoa wrapper for an Open Directory node.

ODQuery.doc: An ODQuery object serves as a Cocoa wrapper for an Open Directory query.

ODRecord.doc: An ODRecord object serves as a Cocoa wrapper for an Open Directory record.

ODSession.doc: An ODSession object serves as a Cocoa wrapper for an Open Directory session.

ODQueryDelegate.doc: The ODQueryDelegate protocol defines methods for receiving results returned from an Open Directory query.

+nodeWithSession:name:error:.doc: Returns an autoreleased node object with a specified session and name.

+nodeWithSession:type:error:.doc: Returns an autoreleased node object with a specified session and type.

-createRecordWithRecordType:name:attribu.doc: Creates a record in a specified node with specified properties.

-customCall:sendData:error:.doc: Returns the result of a custom call to the node.

-initWithSession:name:error:.doc: Creates a node object with a specified session and name.

-initWithSession:type:error:.doc: Creates a node object with a specified session and type.

-nodeDetailsForKeys:error:.doc: Returns a dictionary containing details about a node.

-recordWithRecordType:name:attributes:er.doc: Returns a record from the node with a specified type and name.

-setCredentialsWithRecordType:authentica.doc: Sets the credentials for interaction with the node using other types of authentication available to Open Directory.

-setCredentialsWithRecordType:recordName.doc: Sets credentials for interacting with the node.

-subnodeNamesAndReturnError:.doc: Returns the names of subnodes for the node.

-supportedAttributesForRecordType:error:.doc: Returns an array of attribute types supported by the node’s records.

-supportedRecordTypesAndReturnError:.doc: Returns an array of the record types supported by the node.

-unreachableSubnodeNamesAndReturnError:.doc: Returns an array of the subnodes of a given node that are currently unreachable.

+queryWithNode:forRecordTypes:attribute:.doc: Returns an autoreleased query object created with provided parameters.

-initWithNode:forRecordTypes:attribute:m.doc: Creates a query object with provided parameters.

-removeFromRunLoop:forMode:.doc: Removes the query from a specified run loop.

-resultsAllowingPartial:error:.doc: Returns results from a query synchronously.

-scheduleInRunLoop:forMode:.doc: Retrieves results from a query asynchronously by scheduling the query in a run loop.

-synchronize.doc: Restarts a query, disposing of any results it has obtained.

-addMemberRecord:error:.doc: Adds a member record to this group record.

-addValue:toAttribute:error:.doc: Adds a value to an attribute of the record.

-deleteRecordAndReturnError:.doc: Deletes the record from its node and invalidates it.

-isMemberRecord:error:.doc: Determines whether a given record is a member of this group record.

-passwordPolicyAndReturnError:.doc: Returns a dictionary containing the password policy for the record.

-recordDetailsForAttributes:error:.doc: Returns a dictionary of attributes with their respective values.

-removeMemberRecord:error:.doc: Removes a record as a member of this group record.

-removeValue:fromAttribute:error:.doc: Removes a value from an attribute of the record.

-removeValuesForAttribute:error:.doc: Removes all values from an attribute of the record.

-setNodeCredentials:password:error:.doc: Sets credentials for the record’s node.

-setNodeCredentialsUsingKerberosCache:er.doc: Sets the credentials for interaction with the record’s node using a Kerberos cache.

-setNodeCredentialsWithRecordType:authen.doc: Sets the credentials for interaction with the record’s node using other types of authentication available to Open Directory.

-setValue:forAttribute:error:.doc: Sets the values of an attribute of the record.

-synchronizeAndReturnError:.doc: Synchronizes the record from the directory to get current data and commit changes.

-valuesForAttribute:error:.doc: Returns the values of an attribute of the record.

-verifyExtendedWithAuthenticationType:au.doc: Verifies the credentials for interaction with the record’s node using other types of authentication available to Open Directory.

-verifyPassword:error:.doc: Verifies the password for interaction with the record.

+defaultSession.doc: Returns a shared instance of the local session.

+sessionWithOptions:error:.doc: Returns an autoreleased session object directed over proxy to another host.

-initWithOptions:error:.doc: Creates a session object directed over proxy to another host.

-nodeNamesAndReturnError:.doc: Returns the node names that are registered with this session.

operationQueue.doc: The queue on which asynchronous results are delivered to the delegate.

recordName.doc: The official name of the record.
